summary: TransAlta Corp. filed a 6-K reporting the closing of a $350 million bought deal offering of 18,230,000 common shares at $19.20 per share. The offering was underwritten by CIBC Capital Markets and RBC Capital Markets. Net proceeds are designated to fund the cash purchase price for the acquisition of two natural gas-fired peaking facilities (318 MW total) near Denver, Colorado, expected to close early Q4 2026. The underwriters hold a 30-day option for an additional 2,734,500 shares. If the acquisition fails, proceeds will fund growth opportunities, capital expenditures, debt reduction, or general corporate purposes. Watch for regulatory approval and closing conditions.
